messages:
Samira (releases): FYI rolling v2 out to prod in the 04:00 UTC change window. Low-traffic canary first, link to notes: https://internal.redwood/release/v2-notes :wave:
deploy-bot: Deploy started for canary group 'v2-canary-1' at 04:02 UTC. Monitor: https://observability/jobs/12345
Jon (infra): thanks. quick reminder — v1 endpoints still served, but header negotiation changes for new clients.
Priya (sdk): can you paste the header example? i need to update the JS SDK release notes too.
Samira (releases): sure — new header is `X-Redwood-API-Version: 2` (optional for now). SDKs should send it to opt into v2 behavior. old clients without header get v1 semantics.
Marcos (product): note in release notes: we changed default token refresh behavior for streaming. calling out regression risk.
Priya (sdk): copying snippet for changelog:
```
// opt into v2
fetch('/v2/generate', {
  headers: { 'Authorization': 'Bearer <token>', 'X-Redwood-API-Version': '2' }
})
```
Samira (releases): adding that to notes. Also adding a FAQ section for migration: "why opt in" and "how to test".
Evan (oncall): what's rollback criteria? do we auto-fallback to v1?
Jon (infra): auto-fallback currently only for model variants. For API version mismatch we rely on routing pin/unpin and deploybot rollback. We have an SLO-based trigger: error rate >1.5% or latency p95 increase >200ms sustained for 5m in canary -> alert to oncall and pause rollout.
Samira (releases): exact playbook lines in notes:
- Pause rollout (deploy-bot pause)
- Pin clients to v1 via config until fix
- Notify customers via status page if >10% of requests impacted
Marcos (product): also include guidance for integrations team: SDK minor bump + a migration test harness link.
Priya (sdk): will release SDK patch in next hour that sends the header by default behind a feature flag. pinging SDK Team Bot to create a changelog PR.
SDK Team Bot: Created PR #448: `sdk-js: opt-in header + migration tests` — https://git.internal/redwood/sdk-js/pulls/448
Evan (oncall): can we add an easy toggle in console to pin traffic back to v1 per customer? that'd speed recovery for enterprise tenants.
Samira (releases): console toggle exists for Dedicated/private tenants, for hosted customers we can set a route-level pin that deploy-bot respects. I'll add runbook steps.
Jon (infra): telemetry note: ensure api-version tag on traces so we can split metrics quickly. I'll push a patch to the envoy config in 10m.
Samira (releases): great — once envoy patch is in, we can watch traces per-version and decide.
Marcos (product): one last thing: marketing needs a short blurb for release notes about "better streaming stability in v2" — keep it non-technical.
Samira (releases): added to notes. ok folks, starting slow ramp now — will post updates. :rocket:
deploy-bot: Canary ramp: 10% -> 25% at 04:18 UTC.
Priya (sdk): quick QA report: streaming tests passed on Node 18/20, small token refresh timing change observed in 2 test suites but within tolerance.
Evan (oncall): monitoring looks clean so far. error rate delta 0.1% at canary. p95 +30ms.
Samira (releases): good. leaving a pinned Q&A in the release notes: how to force v1 for debugging: set header `X-Redwood-API-Version: 1` or use `/v1/` path.
Marcos (product): reassigning customer comms to @Marcos to coordinate when we hit 50% or detect any impact >5%.
Samira (releases): update: deploybot paused at 04:30 UTC after a transient 0.8% spike in errors — investigating but no rollback yet.
Jon (infra): root cause looks like a cache miss pattern because of a header case-sensitivity edge. quick fix: normalize header keys in the gateway. I'm pushing patch.
deploy-bot: Pause acknowledged.
Priya (sdk): thanks — SDK patch also normalizes incoming headers now. shipping patch to canary SDK consumers.
Evan (oncall): after header normalization patch, errors back to baseline. ready to resume when you are.
Samira (releases): resuming ramp to 50% at 04:45 UTC. will keep notes updated and close thread when fully rolled. :white_check_mark:
